title: Reentrancy Testing Lab — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Reentrancy Testing Lab solution should meet the objective: In a local-only sandbox, test how an external callback can violate a state invariant, then add a checks-effects-interactions design and/or a guard. Do not test against real services or third-party deployments. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
